title: AI Flow by @mrblackstudio: Been quietly building a browser based live audiovisual studio app for
notes:
Been quietly building a browser based live audiovisual studio app for commercial use in @framer It listens to your music, analyses it in real time, then turns the frequency into visuals, type, glitches, motion, scene changes, FX, and more. It’s node based. Connect audio, MIDI, visuals and behaviours together without needing a PhD in noodles. Build scenes. Chain FX. Map parameters. Make things react to sound and MIDI in near real time (milliseconds latency). Performance Mode splits your controls from the clean projector output where you see the knobs and chaos, everyone else sees the magic. Underneath: frankly ridiculous. To use: surprisingly simple. Code named Signaaal. Sneak peak

Designer: @mrblackstudio. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
